evidence: The feature-comparison table is 474px wide inside a 326px scroll box (scrollWidth 474, clientWidth 326) at 360px. Its last header cell 'Custom CSS' and the right-hand checkmark column are cut at the container edge, so the header reads 'No CS' and the last column of every row is half visible.
fix: Let the table shrink to the container (max-width:100%; table-layout with wrapping cells) or make the overflow explicit with a visible scroll affordance and a fade at the right edge.

evidence: The floated aside keeps width:30% at 360px, so it is only 77px wide inside a 292px article. Its heading wraps as 'This is an / asid / e' and body words break mid-word ('Lore / m / ipsum / dolor / sit / amet / cons ectet ur'). Text is unreadable in three narrow columns.
fix: At narrow widths drop the float and give the aside width:100% (e.g. a max-width media query), keeping the 30% float only on wide viewports.

evidence: The comparison table is 417px wide and centered in a 328px section, so it starts at x=-29 and ends at x=389 in a 360px viewport. The document scrollWidth is 401 (41px of sideways page scroll) and the first column's labels ('Mobile friendly', 'Works out of the box') are cut on the left.
fix: Remove the fixed max-width:80% table sizing and give the table a scroll container (or allow cells to wrap) so it fits within 100% of the content column.

evidence: The textarea uses content-box sizing: computed width 336px plus 12.8px padding and 1px borders, giving a 364px border box from x=38 to x=401, while its form card ends at x=348. The field hangs 53px outside the card and drives the page's 401px scroll width.
fix: Apply box-sizing:border-box and width:100% to textarea/input so the padding stays inside the card.

evidence: The grid wrapper carries the class 'col-sm-121' (typo for col-sm-12), so no column rule matches and the card grows to 2288px wide inside a 352px row. At 360px the document scrollWidth is 2293; at 1440px it is 2534. The card's overflow:hidden clips its own headings and code samples ('To create a progress bar, use the <progress...' cut mid-line), and the page scrolls sideways by ~1900px.
fix: Change the class to col-sm-12 (or add a width:100%/min-width:0 rule for .col-sm-121) so the card matches its parent column.

evidence: The install snippet is pinned to width:610px with margin-right:-250px inside a 360px hero. Its border box runs from x=0 to x=610, so the document scrollWidth is 610 and the page scrolls 250px sideways; the snippet's text is cut at the right edge with no visible scroll cue.
fix: Replace the fixed 610px width with width:100% and max-width:610px, and let the pre scroll horizontally inside its own box.

evidence: The fixed nav is 53px tall, but its menu wraps to a second line: the GitHub and Documentation buttons sit at y=36-72, below the nav's bottom edge, and the nav's scrollHeight is 78px. They cover the nav's divider and the top of the page content, which starts at y=80 ('Contents' heading).
fix: At narrow widths collapse the menu behind the existing burger toggle (as on the Plugins page) or give the nav auto height and enough top padding on main to clear it.

evidence: Same rendered page as p02: the floated aside stays at width:30% and is 77px wide inside a 292px article. The heading breaks as 'This is an / asid / e' and paragraph words break mid-word across a 77px column.
fix: Drop the float and use width:100% for the aside below the mobile breakpoint, keeping the 30% float on wider screens.
